name: Medicale Corp
summary: Medicale Corp. specializes in the distribution of nutritional supplements and offers health-related consulting services within Georgia. Accessible via its online platform, medicalecorp.com, the company's product portfolio includes a diverse range of items such as essential vitamins, minerals, proteins, amino acids, specialized bodybuilding aids, essential fatty acids, natural health products, and probiotics. Additionally, Medicale Corp. maintains an informative blog providing insights into dietary supplements and wellness practices. Established in 2020, the company's operations are headquartered in Tbilisi, Georgia.
